prompt.project_info: Three-concept gym and twilight fitness collection adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Three clearly adult original women in separate concepts: one brunette seated on a light-blue mat in an azure-blue and lime-green crop T-shirt with purple-teal Spain-inspired athletic shorts and red phone case; one platinum-blonde woman wiping her forehead with a gray towel, wearing a royal-blue knotted shirt and neon-lime biker shorts; and one blonde woman with a messy ponytail in a black performance T-shirt taking a close-up gym selfie.
prompt.composition_elements: Concept one is a back-facing mirror selfie in a high-end fitness studio with treadmills, glass windows and Eiffel Tower at twilight. Concept two is a focused post-workout gym scene with mirrored walls and equipment. Concept three is a close-up portrait selfie with industrial ceiling lights and weight machines. Keep each panel distinct.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Twilight city glow and soft studio light in concept one, clean modern gym light in concept two and industrial overhead light in concept three; athletic, tired, focused and urban mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic multi-concept collection, realistic sweat and fabric texture, accurate mirrors, varied selfie and portrait framing; remove unneeded logos while retaining generic sports styling.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Three separate photorealistic fitness concepts with clearly adult original women: a brunette on a light-blue mat in blue-lime crop styling and Spain-inspired shorts taking a back-facing mirror selfie with Eiffel Tower at twilight; a platinum-blonde woman wiping her forehead in a royal-blue knotted shirt and neon-lime biker shorts in a modern gym; and a blonde woman with messy ponytail in a black performance T-shirt taking a close-up sweaty gym selfie, with realistic equipment, mirrors, urban twilight and industrial lighting.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, brand logos, readable text, watermark, duplicate panels, merged scenes, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed anatomy
